# NexusWX Full System Specification & Meteorological Telemetry API Reference
> https://weather.techfliq.com/

This document provides a comprehensive technical overview of the data models, algorithm thresholds, ensemble logic, and API endpoints utilized by NexusWX.

---

## 1. Ensemble Forecast Models
NexusWX aggregates 4 global numerical weather prediction (NWP) models via Open-Meteo:
1. **ECMWF HRES** (European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts - 9km resolution)
2. **GFS** (Global Forecast System - NCEP / NOAA - 13km resolution)
3. **ICON** (Deutscher Wetterdienst - 13km resolution)
4. **JMA** (Japan Meteorological Agency - 20km resolution)

### Consensus Computation
- **Model Disparity Metric**: Computed as the standard deviation $\sigma$ across the 4 models for temperature ($T$), precipitation ($P$), and wind speed ($W$).
- **Agreement Level**:
  - High Consensus: $\sigma_T < 0.8^\circ\text{C}$
  - Moderate Variance: $0.8^\circ\text{C} \le \sigma_T \le 1.8^\circ\text{C}$
  - Model Divergence: $\sigma_T > 1.8^\circ\text{C}$

---

## 2. Hazard & Warning Thresholds
Evaluated continuously in `WeatherWarningsWidget.jsx`:

- **Flash Flood Warning**:
  - Criterion: 24-hour cumulative rainfall $\ge 35\text{ mm}$ OR peak hourly rate $\ge 12\text{ mm/h}$.
  - Advisory: "HIGH FLASH FLOOD RISK — Heavy cumulative rainfall detected. Exercise extreme caution in low-lying areas."

- **Urban Waterlogging Advisory**:
  - Criterion: 24-hour cumulative rainfall $\ge 18\text{ mm}$.
  - Advisory: "URBAN WATERLOGGING ADVISORY — Prolonged rainfall may cause localized street flooding."

- **Extreme Heat Warning**:
  - Criterion: `apparent_temperature` $\ge 38^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Advisory: "EXTREME HEAT HAZARD — Danger of heat exhaustion and sunstroke. Stay hydrated."

- **Dangerous UV Index**:
  - Criterion: `uv_index` $\ge 8$.
  - Advisory: "VERY HIGH UV INDEX — Avoid direct sun exposure between 11 AM and 3 PM."

- **High Wind Warning**:
  - Criterion: `wind_speed_10m` $\ge 40\text{ km/h}$.
  - Advisory: "HIGH WIND WARNING — Strong wind gusts detected. Secure loose outdoor objects."

---

## 3. Location Detection & Hierarchical News Strategy
- **Geolocation**: Browser Geolocation API -> Reverse Geocode via Open-Meteo Geocoding API (`https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search`).
- **Hierarchical News Fallback**:
  1. Town / Village query: `{city} weather OR rain OR flood`
  2. District query: `{state} weather news OR rain`
  3. State fallback: `Kerala weather news OR rain`
- **Domain Exclusion Filter**: Excludes generic aggregators (`msn.com`, `accuweather.com`, `weather.com`, `wunderground.com`).

---

## 4. Primary API Endpoints
- Weather Forecast: `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast`
- Ensemble Comparison: `https://ensemble-api.open-meteo.com/v1/ensemble`
- Air Quality: `https://air-quality-api.open-meteo.com/v1/air-quality`
- RainViewer Radar: `https://api.rainviewer.com/public/weather-maps.json`
